text:
As Canadian Pac Ry LTD (CP) Market Value Rose, 3G Capital Partners LP Trimmed Its Stake by $19.01 Million; Gyroscope Capital Management Group Has Cut Its Oracle (ORCL) Position by $555,264 
March 10, 2018 - By Kurt Siggers 
3G Capital Partners Lp decreased its stake in Canadian Pac Ry Ltd (CP) by 12.09%   3G Capital Partners Lp sold 113,152 shares as the company’s stock rose 4.01% with the market. The hedge fund held 822,482 shares of the railroads company at the end of 2017Q3, valued at $138.20 million, down from 935,634   3G Capital Partners Lp who had been investing in Canadian Pac Ry Ltd for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $26.45B market cap company. The stock increased 1.45% or $2.59   $180.94. About 358,614 shares traded. Canadian Pacific Railway Limited (NYSE:CP) has risen 21.39%   outperformed by 4.69% the S&P500. 
Gyroscope Capital Management Group Llc decreased its stake in Oracle Corp (ORCL) by 28.12%   Gyroscope Capital Management Group Llc sold 11,568 shares as the company’s stock rose 5.35% with the market. The institutional investor held 29,566 shares of the prepackaged software company at the end of 2017Q3, valued at $1.43M, down from 41,134   Gyroscope Capital Management Group Llc who had been investing in Oracle Corp for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $219.28 billion market cap company. The stock increased 1.61% or $0.84   $52.97. About 16.22M shares traded. Oracle Corporation (NYSE:ORCL) has risen 14.08%   underperformed by 2.62% the S&P500. 
Among 28 analysts covering Canadian Pacific ( NYSE:CP ), 20 have Buy rating, 0 Sell and 8 Hold. Therefore 71% are positive. Canadian Pacific had 71 analyst reports since September 30, 2015 according to SRatingsIntel. CLSA upgraded the stock to “Outperform” rating in Tuesday, January 10 report. As per Tuesday, July 25, the company rating was maintained by Argus Research. The stock of Canadian Pacific Railway Limited (NYSE:CP) earned “Buy” rating by Cowen & Co on Wednesday, February 28. The rating was upgraded by TD Securities on Wednesday, October 21 to “Hold”. Buckingham Research maintained Canadian Pacific Railway Limited (NYSE:CP) rating on Thursday, April 21. Buckingham Research has “Buy” rating and $165 target. Morgan Stanley maintained the stock with “Overweight” rating in Tuesday, July 25 report. The firm earned “Equal-Weight” rating on Tuesday, March 15 by Stephens. The stock of Canadian Pacific Railway Limited (NYSE:CP) earned “Buy” rating by Loop Capital on Thursday, August 24. The stock has “Overweight” rating by Morgan Stanley on Wednesday, October 18. The firm has “Hold” rating given on Thursday, August 4 by Loop Capital. 
Analysts await Canadian Pacific Railway Limited (NYSE:CP) to report earnings on April, 18. They expect $2.31 earnings per share, up 21.58% or $0.41 from last year’s $1.9 per share. CP’s profit will be $337.65 million for 19.58 P/E if the $2.31 EPS becomes a reality. After $2.54 actual earnings per share reported by Canadian Pacific Railway Limited for the previous quarter, Wall Street now forecasts -9.06% negative EPS growth. 
Gyroscope Capital Management Group Llc, which manages about $127.73M and $198.17 million US Long portfolio, upped its stake in International Business Machs (NYSE:IBM) by 38,798 shares to 43,739 shares, valued at $6.35 million   increased its holding in Apple Inc (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 6,061 shares in the quarter, for a total of 21,540 shares, and has risen its stake in Amerisourcebergen Corp (NYSE:ABC). 
Among 38 analysts covering Oracle ( NYSE:ORCL ), 28 have Buy rating, 0 Sell and 10 Hold. Therefore 74% are positive. Oracle had 105 analyst reports since July 30, 2015 according to SRatingsIntel. The rating was maintained by BMO Capital Markets on Thursday, March 16 with “Outperform”. The rating was maintained by Wunderlich on Thursday, September 17 with “Hold”. Canaccord Genuity maintained the stock with “Buy” rating in Monday, May 29 report. The rating was initiated by Cowen & Co with “Outperform” on Friday, June 24. As per Wednesday, March 16, the company rating was maintained by UBS. The firm has “Hold” rating given on Thursday, June 22 by Oppenheimer. Pacific Crest maintained Oracle Corporation (NYSE:ORCL) on Friday, June 17 with “Sector Weight” rating. The firm has “Market Perform” rating given on Thursday, March 16 by JMP Securities.
